author: Ifmyante
text:
It's been a great day, seeing so many old friends and new come back to rejoin the community.

A lot of work was put into building this site, but so little of it was done by me.

I'm truly honoured to have found people that share the vision of what we
 will become, and have given so much of their time and expertise into
making this great community home a reality.

You've been steadfast companions, tirelessly working so hard behind the
scenes, that I'm stunned every time I think about the sacrifices you've
made.

So (in alphabetical order, as you appear on skype )

Mel

Harry

Benhur

Kruger

Mertch

FXSniffer

Okami

Whiteout

Thank you all from the bottom of my heart. You've brought something very special to life

author: Ifmyante
text:
I've never explained my complete dream for what we're going to be, as individuals and as a group

Here it is in its very core

We already have massive investors lined up to have us trade for them, so
 every member who gets to the top of the ladder will earn a fortune, and
 then be able to retire if they like, knowing that a group of traders
just as good will be taking over the trading.

I imagine myself working hard for the next couple of years on this
project, setting up the business. I won't have much time, if any, for
trading, but that's OK, because soon the best of YOU will be trading my
money so well I won't need to do it myself.

I've found such an amazing group of very talented people who are so
happy to be involved in this, and can see the potential for all of us,
that we're bound to make this a giant success.

This is a very exciting time!

These are so simple that they can be taught to anybody.

The guys in the trading room will get massive help from those below, knowing it will soon be their time to pass the torch

I love this idea!

author: Ifmyante
text:
Many apologies for not being further along by now with what we're trying to do.

Making progress is a little difficult, as on New Years Day I found
myself homeless (my fiancé got fed up of all the time I had been putting
 into this, and decided enough was enough). As you can imagine, I've had
 a big dose of writer's block since then!

Anyway, I hope today to find an home, with a snug little office where I
can make the lessons, so that one day, hopefully it will all pay off and
 I'll know I didn't do this for nothing.

Wish me luck :)

If
